findings.claim: The user-match check reads integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] without a guard. Integrations whose metadata lacks a 'sender' key (build_integration only adds it conditionally, and older or pre-existing integrations may not have it) raise a KeyError, which produces an HTTP 500.

verifier.reason: GitHubInstallation.dispatch at src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:501-505 directly indexes integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] (line 503) without any guard or KeyError handling. Because GitHubIntegrationProvider.build_integration (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:376-377) only populates "sender" conditionally and pre-existing or pipeline-created integrations lack it, missing keys raise an unhandled KeyError resulting in an HTTP 500.

findings.claim: safe_urlopen() and get_user_info() (which calls raise_for_status()) are outside exception handling. Network errors or non-2xx responses during the token exchange or user fetch cause an unhandled 500 instead of the error() page.

verifier.reason: In OAuthLoginView.dispatch, safe_urlopen() (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:423) sits before the try/except block at lines 425-429, and get_user_info() (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:434), which calls session.get() and resp.raise_for_status() (src/sentry/identity/github/provider.py:9-16), has no exception handling. Because Pipeline.dispatch_to and PipelineAdvancerView.handle do not catch RequestException/HTTPError, network errors or non-2xx responses from GitHub propagate as an unhandled 500 instead of rendering error().
